description: Turn live preflight on or off for the active document or for all documents, choose the working profile and how embedded profiles are used, which layers, pasteboard objects, nonprinting objects and pages are checked, and how many rows per error the Preflight panel lists (Preflight panel menu > Preflight Options, Enable Preflight for All Documents, Limit Rows per Error; preflight status menu)

embedWorkingProfile.description: Embed the working profile into new documents (Embed Working Profile into New Documents)

enabled.description: Turn live preflight on (true) or off (false) (Preflight panel: On)

includeObjectsOnPasteboard.description: Include objects on the pasteboard (Include: Objects on Pasteboard)

pages.description: Pages to preflight: "all", or a range such as "1-4, 7" (Preflight panel: Pages)

panelRowsPerError.description: How many rows the Preflight panel lists per error (Limit Rows per Error); opens the Preflight panel

profilePolicy.description: When opening documents: use the embedded profile or the working profile (Use Embedded Profile / Use Working Profile)

scope.description: The active document's options, or the application's (defaults for all documents; enabled here is Enable Preflight for All Documents)

workingProfile.description: The profile to preflight with (Working Profile); for a document, its embedded profile is found first

name: set_preflight_options
title: Set Preflight Options
